biggest_catch: This is a BUSINESS checking bonus, not consumer — and the $600 tier requires parking $50,000 or more in the new account until the end of the 90-day qualifying period. Offer opens expire September 30, 2026.
catches: This is a business checking bonus; consumer accounts are not eligible.
Open between April 1 and September 30, 2026 with promo code LEVELUP; IOTA/IOLTA and Association Checking are excluded.

Within 90 days of opening you must have 15 or more posted and cleared debit card purchases/payments, OR cumulative ACH credits of at least $5,000 — internal transfers, mobile deposits, debit card deposits, instant payments, and branch/ATM deposits do NOT count as ACH credits.
The $200 balance bonus (the piece that makes $600) requires an available balance of $50,000 or more at the end of the 90-day qualifying period.
Business cannot have a SouthState business/commercial checking account now or in the past 12 months, and cannot have previously received a bonus on an eligible account.
Not available to trusts, employees of SouthState Bank N.A. or its subsidiaries; location and business type restrictions may apply; $50 minimum deposit to open at a branch.
SouthState reserves the right to modify or discontinue the offer at any time without notice.

steps: Open a new SouthState business checking account by September 30, 2026 using promo code LEVELUP (excludes IOTA/IOLTA and Association Checking; $50 minimum deposit if opening at a branch).

Within 90 calendar days of opening, complete either 15 or more posted and cleared debit card purchases/payments, OR cumulative ACH credits of at least $5,000 (internal transfers, mobile deposits, and branch/ATM deposits do not count).
To reach the $600 tier, keep an available balance of $50,000 or more in the new account at the end of the 90-day qualifying period.
Keep the account open with no product-type change through the payment date.
The bonus ($400 base, +$200 balance bonus for $600 total) is credited to your account within 3 business days of the end of the qualifying period.
timing: Bonus payment(s) credited to your account within 3 business days of the end of the 90-day qualifying period.

maximize: Fastest honest path. The qualification period is a fixed calendar window — finishing the required transactions early does NOT pay the bonus sooner; the bank calculates the bonus only after the period closes. Fastest honest path: complete the required transactions in the first week so you can't forget them, then wait out the period with the account open and in good standing.
